name: Waldemar von Kozak
description: Waldemar von Kozak is a Russian illustrator known for his bold, satirical style and retro-inspired digital paintings. His work blends humor, sensuality, and a touch of sci-fi, often featuring pin-up aesthetics, vintage machinery, and cinematic compositions. Kozak’s illustrations are punchy and meticulously crafted, with occasional use of airbrush techniques and typography to enhance visual impact. He’s especially admired for his ability to render cars, planes, and industrial elements with flair and precision.
